title: Tailscale Serve · Tailscale Docs
snippet: Jan 20, 2026 · Run Tailscale Serve If you run the tailscale serve command and your tailnet isn't properly configured to use Tailscale Serve, it presents a login server URL that you can follow to enable the feature. Tailscale Serve lets you serve local directories, files, plain text, or local ports with other devices in your tailnet.

title: Can someone explain to me how Tailscale works and ... - Reddit
snippet: Which brings us to Tailscale. Tailscale leverages your existing SSO logins (Google, Apple, others) and constructs the tunnel transparently with next to no setup from the user. I would feel comfortable giving my Tailscale login to my Mom because the only setup is installing the app and signing in via existing credentials.

title: Tailscale - Wikipedia
snippet: Tailscale Inc. is a software company based in Toronto, Ontario. Tailscale develops an open-source software-defined mesh virtual private network (VPN) and a web-based management service. [b][3][4] The company provides a zero config VPN as a service under the same name.
